text:
Mariana: Heads up — planning a BlueAnchor workshop next Wed 10:00am PT. Focus: Dedicated migration + onboarding checklist. Need to lock accessibility accommodations (live captions, SL interpreter) and decide an APAC-friendly repeat. Draft agenda below.

Kai: +1. Can we do a repeat for APAC? 10am PT is brutal for them. Propose a separate session Fri 8:00am JST or Tue late-night UTC option.

Samir: I can lead the Dedicated migration walkthrough. Will need a 30m hands-on sandbox and 2 hosts to help attendees with provisioning.

Eva: Customer requested live captions and a transcript. Also flagging renewal: usage dipped last month — recommend adding a 1:1 renewal touchpoint after the workshop.

Tony: I can book an SL interpreter and confirm captions. Need to know if BlueAnchor covers interpreting cost or we bill to success budget.

Mariana: Noted. Adding a pre-read and a 3-question pulse at the end to capture immediate CS signals. Calendar event draft + pre-read: https://redwood.example/cs/blueanchor-prep

calendar-bot: Event draft created — Wed Jun 14 2026 10:00 PT — meeting link + captioning toggled on. Repeat slot requested for Fri 8:00am JST.

Samir: For hands-on preflight, add this snippet to the pre-read so folks can test in advance:

```
# create a sandbox user and pin a model for the workshop
redwoodctl accounts create --org blueanchor --sandbox
redwoodctl model pin --org blueanchor --model redwood-dedicated-v1
```

Eva: I'll prepare the 3-question pulse form (NPS-ish + readiness + blockers) and share the link tomorrow. Also putting the renewal follow-up on the CSM calendar: 1:1 scheduled 3 days after workshop.

Kai: Confirmed hosts: Samir + Mariana. I'll draft slides and carve out 15m QA at the end. We should plan for up to 6 breakout rooms for hands-on pairing.

Mariana: Great — @Tony can you confirm interpreter booking by EOD? Also confirm whether BlueAnchor accepts the interpreter fee on their invoice or we invoice internally. :pray:

Tony: Interpreter booking confirmed. BlueAnchor agreed to cover cost (recorded in billing note). :white_check_mark:

Samir: Quick logistical callouts — need 2 dedicated GPU seats for the sandbox, and we should pin model versions to avoid drift during the hands-on. Adding a short rollback reminder in the runbook.

Mariana: Thanks all. I'll update the event details, add pre-read + preflight snippet, include pulse link once Eva shares, and file a short post-workshop renewal summary for the AE. :wave:
